atoms.sound: Hello, Salma. What is your job?
I am an author — I write books.
What type of books do you write?
I write books for teachers! My books talk about the best ways to teach children.

atoms.a: What type of books does Salma write?
b: ++She writes books about the best ways to teach children.
She writes books about the best ways to teach teachers.

atoms.sound: Why do you write your books?
Well,... I want to help teachers become better at teaching.
Is it difficult to write them?
Yes, it can be. I have to read a lot and speak to many teachers to understand their needs better. This normally takes a lot of time.

atoms.a: Why does Salma write her books?
b: ++She writes because she wants to help teachers.
She writes because she has a job.
She writes because she is a good person.

atoms.a: Does Salma find it difficult to write these books?
b: ++Yes, because her research takes a lot of time.
No, because she is a teacher.

atoms.sound: Yes, I do — I love writing! And teachers sometimes tell me that my books are helpful for them. That makes me happy too.

atoms.a: Which of these statements are false?
b: ++Salma loves her job because she hates writing.
Salma is happy when teachers tell her the books are helpful.
